title: Authorize warehouse master data with live menu authority and bounded field validation
description: Stage 3 inventory master-data closure for the warehouse records every stock-in, stock-out, stock adjustment, stock transfer and inventory location/lot query resolves against. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseDataControllers.cs:185-194 declares WarehouseController over BaseCrudController<BaseWarehouse> with only [ApiController]/[Route("api/base/warehouses")]/[Authorize] and no action of its own, so the inherited unguarded generic routes in src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseCrudController.cs:38-92 (backed by src/ERP.Application/Services/GenericService.cs) let any authenticated account list, create, rewrite and delete the warehouses that inventory posting rows point at, while ERP-355/356/436 already guarded the posting and stock-query side. Reuse the existing warehouse functional menu (src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:29) on every route and add bounded server-side validation for the persisted BaseWarehouse columns (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/BaseWarehouse.cs:36-64) before persisting, keeping the existing warehouse-code unique index semantics (src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/ErpDbContext.Config.cs:33) and the existing paging/response contracts unchanged. No grants, no anonymous/admin fallback, no schema change. Genuine isolated (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST SQL only; safe Release build plus full ERP.UnitTests.
acceptance_criteria: For every route on /api/base/warehouses (paged, all, by-id, create, update, delete and batch-delete) require the current enabled nondeleted identity and the existing warehouse functional menu before any read or write, rejecting missing, disabled, deleted and revoked-menu identities with the existing controlled non-disclosing errors and adding no new grants or anonymous/admin fallback.

Validate on create and update that WarehouseCode and WarehouseName are non-empty and within their persisted length bounds, that Address, Manager, Phone and Remark stay within their persisted bounds, and that Status is a known enabled/disabled value, returning the existing controlled validation errors without silently clamping or rewriting any warehouse row and keeping the existing warehouse-code uniqueness semantics unchanged, so a rejected write persists no BaseWarehouses row.

Genuine isolated SQL authenticated controller tests cover the permitted privileged and menu-granted flows, missing warehouse menu, disabled, deleted and revoked identities and invalid code, name, bounds and status payloads, and assert that denied list, create, update, delete and batch-delete calls read or mutate no BaseWarehouses row while the existing GenericService contracts stay green.

Keep the safe Release build and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, use only genuine isolated (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST databases with Integrated Security, and add no schema, entity, menu, permission or production/secret change; build completion is not stage acceptance.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseDataControllers.cs:185-194 declares WarehouseController with only [ApiController]/[Route("api/base/warehouses")]/[Authorize] and no action of its own; the inherited generic routes in src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseCrudController.cs:38-92 call IGenericService (src/ERP.Application/Services/GenericService.cs:31-117) with zero Authoriz/Menu/scope references. BaseWarehouse (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/BaseWarehouse.cs:36-64) persists WarehouseCode/WarehouseName/Address/Manager/Phone/Status/Remark with only attribute annotations and no server-side rule; the unique index is src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/ErpDbContext.Config.cs:33 and the existing warehouse menu is seeded at src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:29. The posting and query sides are already closed by ERP-355 (stock counts), ERP-356 (stock query authorization) and ERP-436 (location/lot reads) but the warehouse master routes they depend on remain unguarded; an exact search of .ai/tasks returned no task listing WarehouseController for live authorization.
